changes: Excerpt: the sections “Medicines Often Taste Bitter” and “Designing Medicines With Children In Mind”, the opening paragraph of “How Do Scientists ‘Hide’ Bad Tastes?” and the subsection “Using Palatable Excipients”. Headings, abstract, figures and reference numbers removed.

questions.prompt: What problem does the text describe?
options: Many medicines taste too bitter for children.
Children often take too much medicine.
Medicines are too expensive for families.
questions.explain: "sometimes medicines taste so bitter that kids do not want to take them" гэж бичсэн. Тийм учраас эрдэмтэд эмийг амттай болгохыг хичээж байна.

questions.prompt: Why is it a good idea to rinse your mouth after some medicines?
options: The sucrose in them can harm your teeth.
The flavors in them can make you feel sick.
Water helps the medicine work faster.
questions.explain: "sucrose can cause tooth decay" гэж бичсэн. Тиймээс сахартай эм уусны дараа амаа усаар зайлахыг зөвлөж байна.
Текстэд "Something palatable is tasty, enjoyable, and pleasant" гэж шууд тайлбарласан.
